export_controls.text:
Incredible news! @xAI will expand its “Colossus” supercomputer facility in Memphis from 100,000 GPUs to at least one million GPUs. Additionally, Nvidia, Dell, and Supermicro Computer will bring operations to Memphis.

This historic investment will pave the way for Memphis to become the global hub for artificial intelligence, revitalize our economy, and lead us further into the next generation of technology. Thank you, @ElonMusk, for making the largest capital investment in our region’s history. I applaud @TedTownsend901 and the entire @MemphisChamber on their leadership and dedication to our community.

deepseek.reason: The statement discusses domestic AI supercomputer investment, not export restrictions or enforcement.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The text is clearly about a Memphis facility and local investment, with no export-control content.

✅ Signed One Big Beautiful Bill: No Tax on Tips, Overtime, extended 2017 Tax Cuts

✅ Record-low border apprehensions: 4,399 with ZERO releases into U.S.

✅ Secured 8 major trade deals: EU, South Korea, Pakistan, Japan, Indonesia, Philippines, China, UK

✅ Unveiled America’s AI Action Plan for U.S. dominance

✅ Banned men from women’s sports

✅ Secured NATO deal for 5% GDP defense spending

✅ Egg prices down 67% from peak

✅ Announced Golden Dome missile defense plan

✅ SCOTUS upheld transgender military ban

✅ S&P 500 & Nasdaq hit record highs

✅ Columbia University paid $200M, ended DEI, improved safety for Jewish students

deepseek.reason: China appears only in a list of trade deals, and AI dominance is not explicitly tied to competition with China.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement mentions China and AI separately but does not endorse China competition as an AI policy priority.
